resources.name: HRIP peptide structure (PDB entry 1RPB)

access.notes: Atomic coordinates of the HIV replication inhibitor peptide, obtainable from the Protein Data Bank.

resources.notes: The initial peptide model was taken from this entry.

resources.name: CHARMM27 all-atom force field

access.notes: Available from the MacKerell lab or via CHARMM-GUI.

resources.notes: Used for peptide bonded and nonbonded interactions.

resources.name: TIP3P water model

access.notes: Standard three-point water model, distributed with most MD software and included in CHARMM force field repositories.

resources.notes: Explicit solvent model used in all simulations.

resources.name: Graphite CNT van der Waals parameters

access.notes: Parameters for carbon atoms in CNTs taken from Walther et al., J. Phys. Chem. B 105, 9980 (2001). The LJ parameters are publicly described and can be manually implemented.

resources.notes: Supplements the CHARMM27 force field for the fixed, uncharged CNT carbon atoms.

access.notes: Open-source MD software. Equivalent engines (e.g., OpenMM, GROMACS) may be used as long as they can reproduce the protocol.

resources.name: VMD visualization and analysis suite

access.notes: Optional tool for visual inspection; trajectory analysis can be done with other scripting libraries (MDAnalysis, MDTraj).

resources.notes: Used in the original study for visualization and secondary structure analysis; not required for the scored numerical artifacts.
